channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: VFS Global issues advisory for Middle East visa applicants amid ongoing Iran conflict
item.description: The advisory comes amid widespread aviation disruption triggered by escalating tensions in the region. Airspace restrictions over Iran and parts of the Middle East have significantly impacted flight operations

item.title: Why paints stocks are down today? How crude prices amid Iran, Israel, US news are impacting the shares
item.description: Asian Paints shares fell 6.12% to Rs 2230.80 against the previous close of Rs 2376.25. Market cap of the firm fell to Rs 2.20 lakh crore.

item.title: US-Israel-Iran War Live Updates: WHO asks for civilians to be spared; Germany, France, UK agree to help US, allies
item.description: US-Israel-Iran War Live Updates: Iranian state TV went off air after one of its transmitters was hit during a strike. Meanwhile, the WHO has asked all parties involved to spare civilian lives.

item.title: Stock impact: Winners & losers from Iran war; primary, secondary effects across 10 sectors
item.description: The US-Iran conflict could present a second-order risk for both tile and PVC pipe players, analysts said. Stocks likely to be impacted include Kajaria Ceramics, Somany Ceramics, Apollo Pipes, Astral and Finolex Cables.

item.title: US halts visa services in Pakistan on March 2 amid deadly protests over Iran conflict
item.description: The US Embassy in Islamabad confirmed that appointments at the embassy as well as at the consulates in Karachi and Lahore would not take place

item.title: OpenAI said ‘Yes’ where Anthropic said ‘No’: Sam Altman's AMA reasons the Pentagon deal
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said, "I have seen what happens in tense negotiations when things get stressed and deteriorate super fast," highlighting the urgency of the deal with the Pentagon.

item.title: Fino Payments Bank MD & CEO arrest: Officials state lender operationally stable, GST evasion by certain programme managers
item.description: Fino Payments Bank doesn't foresee any financial liability, and feels the matter is unlikely to have impact on plans to convert to small finance bank.

item.title: West Asia tensions raise risks for trade, oil prices, Indian markets
item.description: The West Asia and North Africa region account for about 31% of India’s export-import cargo. If the situation worsens, cargo volumes at Indian ports could decline

item.title: How Indian Banks are Witnessing A Great Reset
item.description: How Indian Banks are Witnessing A Great Reset

item.title: From Iranian revolution and Gulf war to Libyan civil war: A look at 25-300% oil price rallies
item.description: Over the past 50 years, oil prices have repeatedly surged 25–300 per cent during geopolitical crises, even when physical supply losses were temporary, Equirus Securities said in a detailed note.
